listing.aiSummary: Adds a new Midline faction focused on technological ascension, featuring six new ship designs and over 180 custom character portraits.

description:
BLACK HALO COVEN

Join us. Transcend the flesh. Achieve Ascension.

The

Black Halo Coven

is a new

Midline faction

for Starsector, built around augmentation, technological ascension, and the belief that humanity was never meant to remain unchanged.

The Church and Path misunderstood Ludd.

The Church chose stagnation.

The Path chose destruction.

We chose Ascension.

FEATURES

• New Midline faction

• 6 new ship designs

• 180+ new character portraits

• New faction star systems and colonies

• Custom faction visuals and soundtrack

• Vanilla-friendly ship design and balance

• Nexerelin support

SHIPS

The Coven fields its own warships alongside familiar Sector technology.

Its original hulls are designed to fit naturally alongside vanilla Midline ships rather than exist as a separate technological ecosystem.

Four of the Coven's hulls are showcased below.

"Cherub"The

Cherub

is a compact Coven combat vessel intended to serve as a reliable and flexible escort hull. Small but disciplined, it reflects the faction's preference for practical battlefield roles wrapped in a distinct ascendant aesthetic.

[close]

"Luminarch"The

Luminarch

is one of the most developed Black Halo Coven hulls and currently has the largest number of variants in the faction. Its adaptable design allows the Coven to field multiple specialized patterns built on the same core chassis.

[close]

"Seraph"The

Seraph

is a larger and more capable Coven warship, offering a stronger battlefield presence and a broader tactical role. It continues the faction's visual identity while expanding into a more imposing and versatile combat platform.

[close]

"Archangel"The

Archangel

stands among the most imposing ships of the Black Halo Coven. Serving as one of the faction's heaviest and most iconic hulls, it embodies their doctrine of disciplined firepower, technological refinement, and ascendant authority.

[close]

Vanilla weapons remain fully viable, and Coven ships are intended to work naturally in mixed player fleets.

>>> DOWNLOAD BLACK HALO COVEN <<<

Current Version:

1.0.2

Starsector Version:

0.98a-RC8

Nexerelin:

Supported

PATCH NOTES

1.0.1

• Updated Archangel graphics and layout

• Updated Seraph graphics and layout

• Luminarch now features 3 distinct variants

1.0.2

• Added 10 custom bounties

• Added an additional variant for each ship

• Updated the Aris Pattern Luminarch sprite

• Updated the Cherub sprite

• Added multiple new descriptions

• Added 160 new character portraits

[close]

Mod Author:

Osart

Credits to

Vexlia Artemiss, Aris, and kirb0o0

for creating Luminarch ship patterns for the mod.

As I'm new to modding, I wanted to start small and gradually add more content over time.

My main goal is to create ships and a faction that feel like a natural part of vanilla Starsector.

Constructive feedback is highly appreciated. ;D
